messages:
sophie-cs: @here NovaDocs just escalated — they saw a sharp drop in retrieval/rerank grounding after the rollout this morning. customer says citations are missing and recall is down across a small set of queries. :warning:

novadocs-support: Hey team — after the deploy around 13:04 UTC our document search started returning fewer citations and some invented answers. Example: query 'How to submit expense reports' used to return three doc links, now returns a short hallucinated paragraph with no sources. We can share sample queries and request IDs.

sophie-cs: Copying the customer's snippet (sanitized):
```
Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d
Endpoint: POST /v1/retrieve_rerank
Payload: {"query": "How to submit expense reports", "top_k": 10}
Response (before rollout): {"results": [{"id":"doc-482","score":0.87,"source":"hr/expenses.md"}, ...]}
Response (after rollout): {"results": [{"id":null,"score":0.12,"source":[] ,"text":"You can submit expenses via email to finance@..."}]}
```
They say this repros on 6/8 example queries we sent.

mike-eng-ml: Thanks — quick context: we promoted ranker-tuned-3 to prod as part of the "similarity-threshold cleanup" rollout at 13:02 UTC (rollout id r-2026-03-17-13). That change tightened reranker scoring and also enabled a new fallback policy that prefers shorter completions when rerank score < 0.2. Could be the threshold is too aggressive for long-tail queries.

alyssa-eng-runtime: infra-bot shows the deployment for r-2026-03-17-13 succeeded across us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Canary window ended at 13:30. We can do a hotfix rollback of the ranker binary; would take ~15-30 min to complete and switch traffic back to ranker-tuned-2.

raj-product: Do we have offline eval metrics comparing recall/precision for that rollout? If this change reduced recall for low-frequency queries that's a product regression. Need a plan: reproduce, rollback (if customer impact), run targeted evals, and postmortem.

mike-eng-ml: I'll run a quick offline rerank eval on NovaDocs' sample set (they provided 320 queries). Initial glance: global MRR down 12%, recall@5 down 18% on their set after the change. Also saw many cases where embedding similarity dropped below 0.25 and triggered the short completion fallback.

novadocs-support: We can share the 320-query CSV and a couple of full request logs (we redacted PII). They are in the ticket: TKT-4432. Customer is pretty upset; wants either a rollback or an ETA on a fix.

alyssa-eng-runtime: Suggest immediate mitigations: 1) temporary rollback of ranker-tuned-3 -> ranker-tuned-2 (fast), 2) if rollback not approved, lower the fallback threshold to 0.05 via feature flag (faster but riskier), 3) enable verbose rerank debug for NovaDocs traffic to capture full scoring trace. Which do you want?

sophie-cs: Customer preference is rollback first. They want to verify search behavior returns to pre-rollout state.

mike-eng-ml: I'll validate that ranker-tuned-2 has better metrics on their test set. If yes, recommend rollback. Also will produce a diff of scoring changes to help diagnose the exact change (similarity weight and penalty terms).

infra-bot: Deployment r-2026-03-17-13 | ranker-tuned-3 | deployed by @deploy-bot | canary end 13:30 UTC | hosts: 24 | rollback window: 2h from canary end.

raj-product: CS please confirm SLA impact and whether this customer should get a credit if rollback not possible. Also schedule an incident follow-up to track RCA and fix timeline.

sophie-cs: Noted. I'll tell NovaDocs we are working a rollback and will update in 30 mins. I'll attach their sample queries and ticket ref.

mike-eng-ml: Action items: 1) me — run quick eval on NovaDocs set and attach MRR/recall numbers (10m) 2) alyssa — coordinate rollback if numbers show improvement (15-30m) 3) sophie — keep customer updated and collect any extra failing examples (ongoing) 4) raj — decide on credits/communication after RCA.

alyssa-eng-runtime: I'll prepare the rollback playbook and a one-line feature-flag to lower the fallback threshold if we need a quicker toggle.

novadocs-support: Appreciate the quick response. We'll hold off on escalation to legal for now pending rollback update.

sophie-cs: Update 30m: Mike's eval shows recall@5 for NovaDocs went from 0.78 -> 0.64 after ranker-tuned-3. We are proceeding with rollback. Alyssa will post when traffic is shifted back.

alyssa-eng-runtime: Rolling back now (starting shift). Will post completion timestamp.

alyssa-eng-runtime: Rollback complete. Traffic back to ranker-tuned-2 as of 1876543810. Please validate with customer's sample queries.

mike-eng-ml: Re-ran the NovaDocs set on ranker-tuned-2 — recall@5 back to 0.79, MRR restored. I'll follow up with a more detailed diff and a plan to fix the tuned-3 scoring changes (likely over-penalized long docs).

sophie-cs: Customer confirmed improvement. Closing ticket if no further regressions. Thanks team. :tada:
